read.thesis: Reported revenue up only 1.5% YoY to ₹8,671 Cr on lenalidomide decline, but base business grew double digits and EBITDA margin rebounded to 20.6%; PSAI API volumes weak at 9.5% gross margin.

triggers.label: Base business double-digit growth ex-lenalidomide
triggers.quote: Double-digit underlying base business^ YoY growth

triggers.label: Lower API volume offtake, PSAI gross margin 9.5%
triggers.quote: Lower API volume offtake impacting growth

red_flags.label: Semaglutide API batches out of specification; ₹240 Cr provision in Q1
red_flags.quote: certain batches were found to be out of specification

red_flags.label: Multiple Form 483 / 2953 observations at several sites
red_flags.quote: Received a Form 483 with 2 & 3 observations respectively

growth.why: The brief gives only a double-digit underlying base business growth quote (ex-lenalidomide) and notes lower API volume offtake; no revenue guidance, capacity additions, or backing numbers are provided, and the semaglutide supply guidance is not repeated in this document.
